LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public high-score entry for an Echo Meadow Run player, keyed by a device-local player ID with no login required.

playerId.description: Stable device-generated identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

playerName.description: Public arcade display name chosen by the player on their device.

bestScore.description: Highest score achieved by this player across runs (0 to 10,000,000).

bestDistance.description: Farthest distance reached in meters (0 to 1,000,000).

coinsCollected.description: Gold coins collected during the player's best run (0 to 1,000,000).

pinkCoinsCollected.description: Pink Star Coins collected during the player's best run (0 to 100,000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player first joined the leaderboard.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player's entry was last updated.

/leaderboard/{playerId}.description: Global synced high-score leaderboard entries readable and writable without sign-in, hardened by strict schema, size, timestamp, and monotonic high-score guards.
